1.

The word of God’s love I hear, That He looks upon the blood; He looks upon the offering that has died, And this gives me peace.

2.

It is an eternal peace, As sure as His word, As steadfast as His firm faith; It was made at the cross.

3.

My love is small, My joy has variation; His peace knows no change, It remains as it was.

4.

I often change, But Jesus is ever the same; His love is my place of rest, His truth makes me rich.

5.

And He Himself is my peace, My distress has reached its end; For I am assured, it was for me He died and has risen.

6.

At God’s right hand He now sits exalted, I rest in His faithfulness, His love is my joy.
